systems.name: RLCard limit-holdem
systems.citation: Zha, D., Bhat, Z., Lai, K.-H., Yang, F., Jiang, Z., Zhong, S., & Hu, X. (2019). RLCard: A toolkit for reinforcement learning in card games. arXiv:1910.04376.
systems.state_action_semantics: 2-player limit Texas Hold'em; discrete action set {fold, check/call, raise}; obs vector + raw legal actions per seat
systems.seed_handling: env.seed(s) -> game.np_random (legacy RandomState); study spawns dealer/agent substreams via numpy SeedSequence(s).spawn(2)
systems.trace_definition: per-hand trajectory tuples (hand, step, player, action) + terminal payoff sum; declared projection = sha256 of trajectory + outcome + step count
systems.event_ontology: semantic deal events keyed 'deal|h|step|p'; dealer shuffle fingerprints logged per hand
systems.arms: A: seat0 random agent; B: seat1 conservative agent; estimand = chips won by seat-0 agent over 10 hands
limitations: limit-holdem betting legality independent of cards simplifies some dynamics

systems.name: 2D Ising Metropolis Monte Carlo
systems.citation: Dehigaspetiyage Don, S. Y. (2026). ising-monte-carlo-toolkit v0.1.0 [Computer software]. GitHub.
systems.state_action_semantics: L×L spin lattice {-1,+1}^N; sweep = N single-spin-flip attempts; observables magnetization/energy per measurement interval
systems.seed_handling: model.set_seed(s) + MetropolisSampler(model, seed=s); both np.random.Generator; study replaces model._rng with logging/keyed wrappers
systems.trace_definition: |magnetization| trajectory at every 10th post-equilibration sweep; declared projection = trajectory hash + terminal value + count
systems.event_ontology: attempt-level events keyed by call counter ('site|k', 'acc|k') in keyed mode; stateful mode logs values+index
systems.arms: A: T_a=2.269; B: T_b=2.9; estimand = mean|magnetization| difference over 90 sweeps (equilibration 20)
limitations: pure-python path used for draw transparency (~slower)
critical slowing down near Tc limits equilibrium claims; study compares fixed-budget observables only

third_system_policy: Mesa ABM added only if pilot wall-clock < 25% of budget; not exercised in this campaign.
